facts.value: Types of education are often divided into levels or stages. The most influential framework is the International Standard Classification of Education, maintained by the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO). It covers both formal and non-formal education and distinguishes levels based on the student's age, the duration of learning, and the complexity of the discussed content.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Education in Educational Studies

facts.value: The levels include early childhood education (level 0), primary education (level 1), secondary education (levels 2–3), post-secondary non-tertiary education (level 4), and tertiary education (levels 5–8).
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Education in Educational Studies

facts.value: Early childhood education, also known as preschool education or nursery education, begins with birth and lasts until the start of primary school. It follows the holistic aim of fostering early childhood development across the physical, mental, and social domains.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Education in Educational Studies

facts.value: Primary (or elementary) education usually starts between the ages of five and seven and lasts for four to seven years. Its main goal is to teach basic skills in reading, writing, and mathematics.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Education in Educational Studies

facts.value: Secondary education follows primary education and usually covers the ages of 12 to 18 years. It is commonly divided into lower secondary education and upper secondary education.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Education in Educational Studies

facts.value: Tertiary education expands upon the foundations of secondary education but has a more narrow and in-depth focus on a specific field or subject. Its completion leads to an academic degree.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Education in Educational Studies

facts.value: In most countries, primary and secondary education are free of charge. There are significant global differences in the cost of tertiary education.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Education in Educational Studies
